That identifies timed packing and scratch access as concrete work, but does not establish a cache bottleneck or predict its timing impact. Test constant_shape_512 first: it keeps the existing transpose and fallback, so its main correctness risk is the new fixed-size compute path. Test cache_conflict_layout second: padding changes the pack stride, both compute-loop loads, rewinds, and allocation bounds; a mismatch can cause incorrect results or out-of-bounds access. The earlier sixteen-panel experiment passed correctness but showed mixed paired results and no repeatable gain, so it does not support a performance claim for either proposal.
